'''Hypersonic Communications Consoles''' were installed on [[Wanderer Scout Surveyor]]s, situated at the top of their spherical bodies. They allowed the Wanderer units to communicate with each other on hypersonic frequencies to coordinate their efforts.<ref name="EGTD" />
